verdict.rationale: ReadMe's GitHub AI Writer is a first-party background automation: it watches pull requests and proposes doc updates when code changes affect the docs. That is an autonomous, event-triggered agent behavior, but it is a single fixed workflow rather than general user-defined automations. Docs Audit is a one-off single-pass run with no evidence of a recurring schedule, so it adds no credit. Missing for 10: user-configurable custom automations, scheduled/recurring background runs, triggers beyond pull requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The GitHub AI Writer keeps your documentation in sync with your codebase by watching your pull requests and proposing updates when code changes affect your docs.
Proposes documentation updates when pull requests change your codebase.
